description.value:
Frequency 1/round

Requirement You've drawn blood from your Marked quarry this turn

Loose a wide double-strike: make a Strike against the quarry as normal; each other creature adjacent to it takes your weapon's damage (no ability modifier added) in the same type as that hit, with a basic Reflex save against your class DC.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Mark itself is now built (waywarden.mark-quarry.json grants TokenMark slug 'quarry'). This card's real blocker is independent: it's an AoE-on-hit action with its own save-DC block, and this corpus's "type": "action" cards carry no save/damage schema fields to hang a basic-save AoE off of (unlike a spell record) -- building it would mean authoring a bespoke action structure this corpus has no precedent for.
